result.summary: Suppresses UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer integer warnings in PeerManagerImpl::ProcessGetCFCheckPt. It adds entries for unsigned integer overflow and implicit signed integer truncation to test/sanitizer_suppressions/ubsan.
result.problem: When running tests compiled with -fsanitize=integer, PeerManagerImpl::ProcessGetCFCheckPt triggers sanitizer errors whenever stop_index->nHeight is smaller than CFCHECKPT_INTERVAL, because headers.size() - 1 produces an underflow/sign-change before the loop is skipped.
evidence: PR description reproduces the UBSan failure: "SUMMARY: UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer: unsigned-integer-overflow /bitcoin/src/net_processing.cpp:3662:33" and "SUMMARY: UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer: implicit-signed-integer-truncation-or-sign-change /bitcoin/src/net_processing.cpp:3662:18"
result.card: Suppresses UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer integer warnings in PeerManagerImpl::ProcessGetCFCheckPt by updating test/sanitizer_suppressions/ubsan. When stop_index->nHeight is smaller than CFCHECKPT_INTERVAL, an empty headers vector causes loop-bound arithmetic to underflow and trigger -fsanitize=integer. While the calculation is harmless at runtime because the loop never executes, the warning causes sanitized test runs to fail.

risk.why: It only adds suppression rules to the UBSan configuration file and does not modify production code.
